low_complexity_rule: EBNA1 window entropy < 3.0 bits or one residue above 30%
ordering: shortlist first, then null_cleared, then margin_z descending
ordering_caveat: margin_z is not selective (s72 keeps 0.92 of the pool at z>=3 and 0.42 at z>=6, recovering 0 of 4 published mimics); null_cleared is a hard ceiling, not a p-value
shortlist_rule: aln_len >= 20 and identity >= 40.0 and (CNS or surface or accessible)
